_meta.notes: DERIVED from the same synthetic roster, cut down to one row of each kind so Available, Locked and Eligibility unknown are all on screen at once: 1 active, 2 the game said yes to, 2 it refused, and 3 rewritten to the unanswered state. A real career cannot hold this mixture, since the facility answers for the whole roster or none of it; it exists to put the three headings side by side.

active.title: Upper Atmosphere Survey
active.description: Upper Atmosphere: an effort with a single clear aim. This effort asks the agency to carry its work somewhere it has not yet been able to reach. The work draws on the same launch facilities as everything else, so it competes for pad time with the rest of the agency. Findings are published to every department at once, so no single team owns what is learned. Early flights will be short and cautious, and each one is expected to return more than it cost. Instruments carried on these flights are built to a common standard so that later missions can reuse them. The first phase is deliberately modest; the later phases assume the first one went well. Success is measured against a schedule agreed at the outset, and a missed milestone is reported rather than hidden. A lead appointed here brings their own priorities, and the rest of the agency adjusts around them. This effort asks the agency to carry its work somewhere it has not yet been able to reach. The work draws on the same launch facilities as everything else, so it competes for pad time with the rest of the agency. Findings are published to every department at once, so no single team owns what is learned.
active.effect: Effects: * Pays 600,000 over 5 years as survey milestones land.
